brief: Prioritise Willow Bend 138/13kV (SUB-SGW-717) for pre-event attention ahead of a younger unit in otherwise similar condition because it is a unit of advanced age with a history of high loading and has a reduced margin against mechanical failure [MG-023]. Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023].
